facts.looks-up: A young person looks up at the tip of a wand held upright in both hands.
facts.feather-hat: The young person wears a hat with a red feather stuck in it.
facts.salamander-tunic: The yellow tunic has black salamander patterns drawn on it.
facts.boots: The yellow boots have flame-shaped ornaments.
facts.pyramids: Three pyramid-shaped hills can be seen on the sandy-colored ground behind.
facts.blue-sky: The background is a blue sky.

glosses.looks-up: Looking at new possibilities with curious eyes.
glosses.salamander-tunic: The salamander, said to live even in fire; a passion that does not cool.
glosses.pyramids: Interest in a faraway place not yet visited.

reversedGloss.excess: Excitement runs ahead, with much talk and scattered action.
reversedGloss.blocked: Wanting to try, but lacking the confidence to make a first attempt.
